distribution.summary: 黑龙江；吉林；内蒙古；陕西；湖南；四川；云南；青海；福建
distribution.narrative: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) reported 黑龙江（带岭），吉林（抚松），内蒙古（呼伦贝尔），陕西（石泉，留坝，沔县，建庄），湖南，四川（德昌），云南（思茅，西双版纳）. 黄复生等 (2015) reported 黑龙江，吉林，内蒙古，陕西，湖南，四川，云南，青海，福建. These are literature-based records; Mainland China remains Candidate pending occurrence review.

host_note: Host names are retained as published; each association is linked to its cited source. These records have not undergone independent host review.
